annotations.title: Get Ticketmaster events and price ranges on your own key

description: Give search keywords, a city, country, category, or date range, or Ticketmaster event IDs, plus your own free Ticketmaster Discovery API key. Returns one row per event with date, venue, status, and the price range (min, max, currency) when the API has one. Price ranges are face value ranges, not seat or resale prices. Pay per event on Apify: 0.003 USD per event row.

api_key.description: Your own Consumer Key from developer.ticketmaster.com (free). It is stored encrypted by Apify, sent only to Ticketmaster, and never written to a row or a log. With no key the run writes one free row and reads nothing.

city.description: Optional. City name, for example Chicago.

classification.description: Optional. A segment, genre, or sub genre name, for example music, sports, rock, or comedy.

country_code.description: Two letter country code, for example US, CA, GB, AU, or DE. Default US. Write any to search every country.

end_date.description: Optional. Events on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

event_ids.description: Optional. Ticketmaster Discovery event IDs (for example G5diZfkn0B-bh) to read one by one. These ignore the filters.

keywords.description: Artist, team, show, or event words. Each keyword runs as its own search with the filters below. Leave empty to search by the filters alone. In Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_events_per_search.description: Number, default 100, at most 1000. The Discovery API pages no deeper than 1,000 events per search.

only_with_prices.description: yes or no (default no). yes skips events the API returns with no price range; skipped events are not charged.

start_date.description: Optional. Events on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC).

state_code.description: Optional. State or province code, for example NY or ON.

name: get_ticketmaster_event_prices
title: Get Ticketmaster events and price ranges on your own key
